senses.gloss: anything used to fill up a gap (cmp. חֶדֶק), stop-gap, stopper.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Shabbat 17:7">Sabb. XVII, 7</cite> <he>פ׳ החלון</he> the stopper of the sky-light (compluvium), v. <cite ref="Q01514"><he>פָּקַק</he></cite>. Tosef. Erub. XI (VIII), 9 <he>נוטל את הפ׳ וכ׳</he> he may take out the stopper between the two reservoirs &c.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Terumot 8:3:20">Y. Ter. VIII, 45ᵈ</cite> <he>אם היה הפ׳ חוצץ</he> (not <cite ref="H00429"><he>חוץ</he></cite>) if the stopper (of the bottle) is tight; <cite ref="Tosefta Terumot 7:16">Tosef. Ter. VII, 16</cite> (correct version in agreement with Y. l. c., v. <cite ref="Q01514"><he>פָּקַק</he></cite>). Y. l. c. <he>כדי שינטל בפִיקְקוֹ</he> so that the bottle can be lifted by its stopper; a. fr.

senses.gloss: the place where a shoot is joined to the trunk or to a branch of the grape vine, knot.
units: <cite ref="Bava Kamma 81a:9">B. Kam. 81ᵃ</cite> <he>מן הפ׳ ולמעלה</he> (you are permitted to take a shoot from a neighbor’s vine) from the knot and above it.
